changelog.name: v1.9.0
changelog.body:
A full bug report system inside the app, end-to-end encrypted and tied to the release that fixes it.

- **End-to-end encrypted reports.** Your message and module log are sealed on the phone with HPKE (X25519 and AES-256-GCM) and only the developer's key opens them. The server holds no private key. Questions and notes from the developer are sealed to a reply key that only your phone holds, wrapped by Android Keystore. Settings, Report a bug lists the full specs with links.
- **Follow your report.** Each report shows its status, the latest note, a Reply button while a question is open and a link to the GitHub issue once there is one.
- **Fixes you can see.** A report closes only when a release really carries the fix for its issue. That release note line is marked "Fixes your report" in the update card.
- **Opt-in.** Nothing leaves the phone until you tap Send encrypted report. Sharing hook status is now off by default, and the automatic update check has its own switch.
- **Settings.** Grouped into Updates, Support, Dashboard, Privacy and About. The module log moved to Support.
- **Dashboard.** App icons on section headers, tweak icons on rows, option rows nested inside their tweak card and an option to hide tweaks your phone cannot load.
- **Hot reload.** Each process shows its app icon and name, and the version chip appears only when a process runs an older build.
- **Motion and layout.** Shared axis screen transitions with a scaled predictive back. Sheets open below the status bar and fit short screens.

Requires Android 14 or later.

[![libxposed API 102](https://img.shields.io/badge/libxposed_API-102-ff69b4?style=flat-square)](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/io.github.libxposed/api) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/hxreborn/PixelInjector?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/hxreborn/PixelInjector/releases/latest) [![Android 14+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-14%2B-3DDC84?style=flat-square&logo=android&logoColor=white)](#install) A modular Xposed module of Pixel tweaks, each behind its own switch. I built it for my own phone, but if a tweak is useful to you and breaks on your build, I can adapt or fix it on demand. - **One switch per tweak.** Off tweaks change nothing. - **Applies instantly.** Switches take effect live, and updates hot reload through libxposed API 102 with no reboot. > [!NOTE] > I build and test it on Pixel phones. On other ROMs a tweak can miss its target. For LineageOS and other ROMs with public source, I fix the tweak from that source. A closed ROM like HyperOS, One UI or ColorOS has no source to read, so the fix needs that ROM's own SystemUI or `services.jar`.
Screenshots
## Install Needs Android 14 or newer, arm64, root and an Xposed framework with libxposed API 102 (LSPosed 2.x or Vector). 1. Download the APK from [Releases](https://github.com/hxreborn/PixelInjector/releases/latest) or the [Xposed Modules Repo](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/eu.hxreborn.pixelinjector/releases). 2. Enable PixelInjector in your Xposed manager and select the apps of the tweaks you need in its scope. 3. Reboot once. Later updates install from the app and reload without a reboot. ## Tweaks ### System UI - **Warm Tiles**: raises the limit of [3](https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/base/+/d5a204f16e7c71ffdbc6c8307a4134dcc1efd60d/packages/SystemUI/src/com/android/systemui/qs/external/TileServices.java#37) bound tiles in Quick Settings. Same hook as [qs-boundless-tiles](https://github.com/hxreborn/qs-boundless-tiles). - **PillShot**: draws the app name on screenshots. Skips the selected apps or stamps only them. Revived from eXtreames/PillShot after its repo disappeared. - **Mute screenshot sound**: skips the screenshot shutter sound. - **Empty shade message**: replaces the empty shade's trophy and text with your own text and one of 141 icons. Android 17 only. - **Always expand notifications**: opens notifications expanded unless you collapsed one by hand. - **Pin ongoing notifications**: stops swiping away ongoing notifications like media and VPN. - **Charging details**: adds watts, volts, amps and battery temperature under the lock screen charging text. - **Download chip**: shows a download's progress as a chip in the status bar. Ported from [Iconify](https://github.com/Mahmud0808/Iconify)'s ongoing action chip. - **Fingerprint icon**: replaces the lock screen fingerprint icon with one of 24 icons from custom ROMs or your own image and can hide the circle behind it. Phones with an under-display fingerprint sensor. - **Heads-up duration**: sets how long a heads-up notification shows, from 1 to 15 seconds. - **Double tap status bar to sleep**: double tap empty status bar space and the phone sleeps. - **Biometric Bypass**: taps confirm on the biometric prompt after a face unlock and plays a system sound of your choice. Same hook as [biometric-bypass](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-bypass). ### System Framework - **Force NEW_TASK**: adds NEW_TASK to activity starts that match your rules, one `source:target` per line. - **Clipboard in background**: allows selected apps to read the clipboard in the background. ### Launcher - **Double tap to sleep**: double tap empty home screen space and the phone locks and sleeps. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3. - **Hide gesture pill**: makes the navigation handle transparent and keeps a chosen percent of the bottom inset under apps. A percent change restarts the launcher. - **Hide search bar**: hides the search bar above the hotseat and frees the row it reserves. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3. - **Hide app shortcuts**: a long press on an app shows only the system actions. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3. - **Home menu entry**: adds PixelInjector to the home screen long press menu. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3. > [!WARNING] > Double tap to sleep runs `su` from Pixel Launcher. With KernelSU and APatch, grant root to Pixel Launcher by hand in the manager, not only to PixelInjector. On KernelSU it shows up after you turn on Show system apps. ### Gboard - **AMOLED black keyboard**: makes the tinted grey keyboard surfaces pure black in dark mode. Stock Gboard and the Morphe build. Toggling restarts Gboard. Same hook as [gboard-material-expressive-black](https://github.com/hxreborn/gboard-material-expressive-black). ### Phone - **Remove feedback chip**: removes the Help us improve chip from the call list. Same hook as [gdialer-dechip](https://github.com/hxreborn/gdialer-dechip). ### File picker - **Force sort by newest first**: opens folders newest first in the file picker and the storage browser. Same hook as [remember-my-sort](https://github.com/hxreborn/remember-my-sort). ### KDE Connect - **KDE Connect Quiet**: stops KDE Connect from holding the Wi-Fi multicast lock. Toggling restarts KDE Connect. ### GitHub - **GH FastPass**: closes the GitHub app's approved 2FA dialog right away. Same hook as [gh-fast-pass](https://github.com/hxreborn/gh-fast-pass). ## Report a bug Report from the app or on [GitHub](https://github.com/hxreborn/PixelInjector/issues/new/choose), whichever you prefer. App reports are opt-in and end-to-end encrypted. Nothing leaves the phone until you tap Send. On a phone that isn't a Pixel and doesn't run an open source ROM such as LineageOS, a report about a System UI or System Framework tweak also sends that ROM's SystemUI or `services.jar` code, encrypted with the report. 1. Open Settings, tap Report a bug, say what happened and send. 2. Follow it in Your reports. My questions and the GitHub issue show there. 3. The update that fixes it says Fixes your report. Or reach me at [hxreborn@duck.com](mailto:hxreborn@duck.com) or on [Telegram](https://t.me/hxreb0rn).

Bound to the ciphertext as [associated data](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9180#section-5.2) | | Developer key | `3d76ec6a` | | Reply key | X25519 per report, wrapped by [Android Keystore](https://developer.android.com/privacy-and-security/keystore) | | Server | `reports.hxreborn.eu` holds no private key | | Redacted log data | Emails, phone numbers, IP and MAC addresses, Wi-Fi names, device and advertising IDs, storage paths, URL and header tokens ([Redactor](https://github.com/hxreborn/PixelInjector/blob/main/app/src/main/kotlin/eu/hxreborn/pixelinjector/support/Redactor.kt)) | | Retention | 90 days | | Update check | On by default in Settings.
